scope: breakpoint proof: the client never reaches the snapshot parser

experiment.handshake: full ring bridge through CS_ACTIVE with the EOF=5 server (enterworld12)
experiment.result: events.jsonl contains 149 module events, 64 exceptions (all CRT/system: 0x80000003, 0x4000001f, 0x406d1388 thread naming) and 4 debug strings from lansp_c.dll -- no snapshot_parse breakpoint hit at all

meaning: 0x471E90 (client svc 0 = snapshot handler) is never entered. The client receives packets and settles at phase 8 but the message is discarded or fails validation before dispatch, so the snapshot body never gets parsed. This supersedes the body-format hypothesis as the first gate.

a breakpoint at 0x473BAA (the svc dispatch compare) would show whether the reader loop is reached at all
